newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 12.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 12.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 32.91 points to close at 7,169.53 after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan appeared to back away from favouring another rise in short-term interest rates.

* The Indonesian government is looking for additional sources of funds, apart from a $1.3 billion loan from a consortium of domestic private and state-owned banks, to finance its national car programme, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper quoted Industry and Trade Minister Tunky Ariwibowo as saying.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index rose 6.85 points to close at 673.69 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,427.25/27.75 at 0150 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,426.50/27.50.
* Automobile conglomerate Astra on reports the government was seeking additional loans to finance the national car programme.
* Selamat Sampurna on a Neraca newspaper report that it has agreed to supply automotive parts to Bakrie Motors.
* Cocoa grinding firm Cahaya Kalbar on market talk of a possible rights issue to acquire a trading firm.
* Conglomerate Bakrie & Brothers on reports that the firm was holding talks with possible joint venture partners to build a steel plant in Lampung.
